title: Masal Gezgini Tina
author: Funda Nur Uşaklı
description: At bedtime, Tina asks her father to read her favorite fairy tales. But as the familiar stories unfold, she notices that the heroines do not even have names and always seem to wait for a prince to save them. Tina questions these old patterns and imagines new possibilities where heroes are named, girls make their own choices, and adventures can happen anywhere. With a notebook, colorful pencils, and an unstoppable imagination, Tina becomes a Story Wanderer who enters stories, reshapes them, and finds her own path. The book celebrates creativity, independent thinking, and the joy of storytelling.
